articles.headline: Hong Kong Told to Look Beyond Rankings to Win Over International Students
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s much-promoted "Study in Hong Kong" campaign should look past institutional league tablesranked lists comparing the performance of institutions排名榜 if it genuinely wants to keep hold of overseas talent, leaders from several leading British universities argued recently, as the city’s publicly funded institutions prepare more than 160 recruitment events overseas and across the mainland this academic year.

Duncan Ivison, president and vice-chancellor of the University of Manchester, said Hong Kong could draw inattract and bring into a place吸引 international scholars not merely through its rankings but through research initiatives such as InnoHK, which pair overseas academics with local laboratories. He and other speakers argued that rankings alone cannot compensate formake up for a lack or disadvantage彌補 the absence of clear, government-backed career incentives once students graduate.

Hong Kong already offers the Immigration Arrangements for Non-local Graduates, which lets students who complete a full-time local degree stay for up to 24 months to search for work, alongside a dedicated entry routea pathway or channel for entering a place or system入境途徑 under the Top Talent Pass Scheme for recent graduates of top overseas universities. Speakers at the forum argued that these schemes need to be publicisedmade widely known to the public宣傳；公開 far more aggressively alongside academic rankings if Hong Kong hopes to compete with destinations such as Singapore and Australia, where post-study work rights are already a selling pointan attractive feature used to persuade someone to choose something賣點 in their own recruitment pitches, rather than an afterthought buried in immigration paperwork.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港大力推廣的「留學香港」計劃,若要真正留住海外人才,就應該不再只倚重院校排名榜,多位英國頂尖大學校長近日在一場論壇上提出這個觀點,同時香港多所資助大學正籌備在本學年舉辦逾160場海外及內地招生活動。

曼徹斯特大學校長伊維森(Duncan Ivison)表示,香港除了憑藉排名外,亦可透過InnoHK等研究計劃,將海外學者與本地實驗室配對,藉此吸引國際學者。他與其他發言者認為,單靠排名並不能彌補畢業後缺乏明確、由政府支持的職業激勵措施這個缺口。

香港現時已設有「非本地畢業生留港/回港就業安排」,讓完成本地全日制學位課程的學生可留港最多24個月求職,另設有「高端人才通行證計劃」下專為頂尖海外大學畢業生而設的入境途徑。論壇發言者認為,這些計劃需要與學術排名一併更積極地宣傳,香港才有望與新加坡、澳洲等地競爭——這些地方早已將畢業後工作權利列為招生宣傳中的賣點,而非埋藏在移民文件中的附帶條款。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Athletics Faces Funding Reckoning After Asian Games Shutout
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s athletics squad returned from the Asian Games in Nagoya without a single medal, despite fielding 38 competitors across the track-and-field programme — a shutouta result in which a side scores or wins nothing at all全軍覆沒 that has reopened a bruising debate over how elite sport is funded in the city. Only three of the 38 athletes managed to advance pastprogress beyond a stage in a competition晉級；超越 the qualifying rounds in their medal events, underlining how far the discipline has fallen behind regional rivals.

Funding at the Hong Kong Sports Institute is explicitly tied to resultslinked directly to performance outcomes與成績掛鈎, and several national sports associations, including tennis, now sit in an "observation period" that could see their subsidies slashedcut drastically大幅削減 after failing to reach the podium in Nagoya. One veteran coach went further, arguing that the current system is enabling mediocrityallowing an unremarkable standard to continue unchallenged縱容平庸 by handing out cash to athletes with little chance of international success, and describing the sport as having been "on life support" through three barren years.

The contrast with Hong Kong’s broader Asian Games record only sharpens the criticism. Three years earlier, in Hangzhou, long jumper Tiffany Yue Nga-yan delivered athletics’ only bronze as the city as a whole racked upaccumulated a large number of something累積（大量） a record 53 medals across all sports. Officials now face a balancing acta situation requiring careful management of competing demands兩難局面；平衡難題 between nurturing promising but unproven athletes and redirectingsending resources to a different destination or purpose重新調配 scarce funding toward sports that can still deliver medals, with the next major Games cycle offering little time to reverse the slide.
articles.summary_zh_html:

香港體育學院的資助制度明確與成績掛鈎,包括網球等多個全國性體育協會因未能在名古屋站上頒獎台,目前正處於「觀察期」,一旦未達標,資助隨時會被大幅削減。有資深教練更直言,現行制度正在縱容平庸,把資金派給一些根本難以在國際賽事中取得成績的運動員,並形容該項目經歷了「三年乾旱」,一直「靠呼吸機維生」。

與香港在亞運會的整體成績相比,批評聲音更顯尖銳。三年前在杭州,跳遠選手余雅妍為田徑隊贏得唯一一面銅牌,當時全港代表團整體更累積破紀錄的53面獎牌。官員現時面對一項兩難局面:既要培育具潛質但尚未證明實力的運動員,亦要將有限資源重新調配至仍有能力奪牌的項目,而下一個亞運周期所餘時間已不多,難以逆轉這股下滑趨勢。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Elderly Urged Indoors as Ozone Pushes Pollution to 'Serious' Levels
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s government warned of a "serious" health risk this week as two days of severe haze blanketedcovered something completely, like a thick layer籠罩 the city, with monitoring stations in Central/Western, Southern, Tsuen Wan, Tuen Mun and Sha Tin all recording "high" health-risk readings by mid-afternoon. Health experts urged elderly residents and other vulnerable groups to stay indoors until after sunset, when pollutant levels were expected to ease.

Officials attributed the spike chiefly to elevated ozone, a pollutant that forms when strong sunlight and high temperatures triggercause something to start happening引發；觸發 photochemical reactions in the air. It was not the first such episode this month: an earlier bout of weak winds had already trappedconfined something so it cannot escape or disperse困住；無法擴散 pollutants over the Pearl River Delta, pushing several stations into the "Serious" category and driving up nitrogen dioxide readings alongside ozone. Scientists could not entirely rule out some residualremaining after the main part of something has ended殘餘的 influence from the subsiding air of a weakening tropical cyclone.

The government advised that children, the elderly and people with existing heart or respiratory illness reduce outdoor activity to a minimum, or avoid it altogether, until a fresh easterly airstream could dispersespread out and scatter something widely驅散；擴散 the haze. Campaigners say such repeated ozone spikes, now a near-monthly occurrence in autumn, show that Hong Kong’s long-term reliance on favourable weatherweather conditions that happen to help a situation有利天氣 to clear its air is no substitute for tougher, year-round emission controls.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港政府本周發出「嚴重」健康風險警示,連續兩日嚴重煙霞籠罩全港,中西區、南區、荃灣、屯門及沙田的監測站在下午時段均錄得「高」健康風險水平。健康專家呼籲長者及其他高危人士留在室內,直至日落後污染水平料會緩和。

官員指,這次污染高峰主要由臭氧濃度上升引發,臭氧是在強烈陽光及高溫下,空氣中發生光化學反應而形成的污染物。這並非本月首次出現同類情況:較早前一輪風勢微弱,已令污染物困住於珠江三角洲上空無法擴散,導致多個監測站錄得「嚴重」級別,二氧化氮讀數亦隨臭氧一同上升。科學家未能完全排除一股減弱中的熱帶氣旋下沉氣流帶來的殘餘影響。

政府建議,兒童、長者及患有心臟或呼吸系統疾病人士應盡量減少戶外活動,甚至完全避免,直至一股清新東風能將煙霞驅散。環保人士指,這種臭氧濃度飆升的情況在秋季幾乎每月出現,反映香港長期依賴有利天氣來淨化空氣,並不能取代更嚴格、全年適用的排放管制。

articles.headline: Jockey Club Backs Youth Summit as Hong Kong Eyes Cross-Border Exchange
articles.summary_html:
Government officials, business leaders and youth representatives from Hong Kong, the mainland, ASEAN countries and beyond gathered at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre for the flagship Hong Kong Youth Development Summit 2026, an event underwrittenfinancially supported or guaranteed資助；擔保 by the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust. Organised by the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau, the summit was pitched as a platform for exchangea forum where different groups can share ideas交流平台 rather than a one-off ceremony, bringing young delegates into direct contact with policymakers and employers.

In a video address, Chief Executive John Lee said that under the city’s first Five-Year Plan, covering 2026 to 2030, the government would step upincrease the level or intensity of an effort加強；提升 opportunities for young people’s development, framing youth policy as part of a longer-term strategic blueprint rather than a series of standaloneexisting or done separately from other things獨立；單一 initiatives. The Jockey Club Charities Trust has committed HK$10 million to this year’s related youthfest@HK programme, continuing as the festival’s principal funderthe main organisation providing financial backing主要資助機構 since 2023.

Supporters say bringing overseas and mainland youth groups into the same room as local students helps widen horizons and build the kind of regional networks that can later translate into career pathwaysroutes or sequences of jobs leading toward a career goal職業發展路徑. Sceptics, however, question whether a single annual summit can meaningfully address the deeper, day-to-day pressures — from housing costs to job insecurity — that weigh oncause worry or burden to someone困擾；造成壓力 many young Hongkongers, warning that glossy flagship events risk becoming substitutes for sustained, harder-to-measure policy follow-through.
articles.summary_zh_html:
來自香港、內地、東盟國家及其他地區的政府官員、商界領袖及青年代表,齊集香港會議展覽中心,出席由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金資助的旗艦活動——香港青年發展峰會2026。這次由民政及青年事務局主辦的峰會,被定位為一個交流平台,而非一次性的慶典儀式,讓青年代表直接與政策制定者及僱主接觸。

行政長官李家超在視像致辭中表示,在涵蓋2026至2030年的香港首個五年規劃下,政府將加強青年發展機會,將青年政策定位為長遠策略藍圖的一部分,而非一系列單一的計劃。賽馬會慈善信託基金已向今年相關的「青年節@香港」計劃捐出1000萬港元,自2023年起一直擔任該活動的主要資助機構。

支持者認為,讓海外及內地青年團體與本地學生共處一室,有助拓闊視野,建立日後可轉化為職業發展路徑的地區網絡。然而,質疑者則提出,單靠一年一度的峰會,能否真正解決那些困擾許多香港青年的深層日常壓力——例如房屋開支及就業不穩定,並警告亮麗的旗艦活動,可能淪為難以量度卻持續不斷的政策跟進工作的替代品。

trends.headline: 🪞 MIRROR's Nostalgic MV Has Hongkongers Reliving Classic Ads
trends.summary_html:
Local boy band MIRROR marked their seventh anniversary with a new music video, "DNA is U," in which all twelve members take turns re-enactingperforming again, acting out something that happened before重演 a string of beloved Hong Kong television commercials from decades past. Within days the clip had drawn more than 230,000 YouTube views and 16,000 likes, while media-monitoring firm CARMA counted over 410 online mentions as fans dissectedexamined something in careful detail仔細分析 each reference.

Marketing commentators say the video’s nostalgic appealthe emotional pull of fondly recalling the past懷舊吸引力 taps into shared memories across generations of Hongkongers who grew up watching the original adverts on television, deepening fan loyalty in ways a conventional single rarely achieves. Not every reaction has been glowingextremely positive or favourable極為正面；讚賞, though: one commentator felt the rapid-fire tribute scenes play more like a disconnected collagea composition made of many different pieces combined together拼貼 than a coherent story, leaving some younger viewers unfamiliar with the original ads to enjoy only the surface spectacle.
trends.summary_zh_html:
本地男團MIRROR為慶祝出道七周年推出全新音樂錄像《DNA is U》,十二位成員輪流重演多個香港經典電視廣告場景。短短數日內,片段已錄得超過23萬次YouTube觀看及1.6萬個讚好,媒體監察公司CARMA統計網上提及次數逾410次,粉絲紛紛逐一仔細分析每個廣告彩蛋。

市場推廣評論員指出,這段影片的懷舊吸引力觸動了跨代香港人共同成長時收看這些廣告的記憶,其鞏固粉絲忠誠度的效果,遠超一般單曲所能達到的層次。不過,並非所有反應都十分讚賞:有評論認為,這些快速剪接的致敬片段更像一幅缺乏連貫故事的拼貼,令部分不熟悉原版廣告的年輕觀眾,只能停留在表面的視覺奇觀。

causes.label: Reclaiming Local Memory Amid Global Pop Culture
causes.label_zh: 在全球流行文化中重拾本地記憶
causes.text: By resurrecting homegrown adverts rather than chasing globally fashionable aesthetics, MIRROR reasserts a distinctly Hong Kong visual heritage at a time when K-pop and Mandopop dominate young people's feeds, inviting students to weigh whether local nostalgia can hold its own against global trends.
causes.text_zh: MIRROR選擇重現本土舊廣告,而非追逐全球潮流美學,在韓流及國語流行曲主導年輕人資訊feed的年代,重新肯定香港獨特的視覺傳承,促使學生思考本地懷舊文化能否在全球潮流夾擊下站穩陣腳。

causes.label: Packaging Collective Memory for Profit
causes.label_zh: 將集體回憶包裝成商業產品
causes.text: An anniversary tribute built from genuinely shared childhood memories doubles as a commercial vehicle for the group's agency, prompting debate over whether packaging collective nostalgia for streaming numbers and merchandise sales cheapens the very memories it claims to honour.
causes.text_zh: 一場建基於真切童年記憶的周年致敬,同時也是經紀公司的商業載體,引發爭議:將集體懷舊包裝成串流數字及周邊商品銷售,是否反而貶低了它本應紀念的那份記憶。

causes.label: A Collage Without a Story: the Limits of Nostalgia Bait
causes.label_zh: 缺乏故事的拼貼：懷舊噱頭的局限
causes.text: Critics note the video strings together references with little narrative glue, meaning viewers too young to recognise the original advertisements may absorb only fast-moving spectacle, raising doubts about whether nostalgia-driven content actually deepens cultural understanding or simply performs well with short-attention algorithms.
causes.text_zh: 批評者指出,影片將多個片段串連,卻缺乏敘事脈絡,意味著太年輕、未能認出原版廣告的觀眾,或只能吸收表面上快速閃現的奇觀,令人質疑懷舊內容究竟是深化文化理解,還是純粹迎合短注意力的演算法。

causes.label: Belonging Through Shared Screens
causes.label_zh: 透過共同畫面建立歸屬感
causes.text: For Hongkongers who have emigrated or feel disconnected from a fast-changing city, watching twelve idols replay adverts everyone once gathered round the television to see offers a rare, unifying sense of belonging, suggesting popular culture can still stitch together a fragmented sense of local identity.
causes.text_zh: 對於已移居海外或在急速變遷的城市中感到疏離的香港人而言,看著十二位偶像重演大家曾齊集電視機前觀看的廣告,帶來一種難得而團結的歸屬感,顯示流行文化仍能縫合日漸碎片化的本土身分認同。
